findings.evidence: Mathlib/FieldTheory/Galois/Abelian.lean:56 and :59 define instances `IsAbelianGalois K K'` and `IsAbelianGalois K' L` for every intermediate field; the new proofs at lines 81–82 and 108–109 are literally `haveI := isAbelianGalois hroot; inferInstance`, while line 89 only projects `.toIsGalois`.
findings.fix: Remove all three declarations; after `haveI := isAbelianGalois hroot`, use the `IsAbelianGalois` intermediate-field instances directly, and obtain `IsGalois` through the superclass instance.
findings.issue: `isAbelianGalois_top_over_intermediateField`, `isGalois_top_over_intermediateField` (line 85), and `isAbelianGalois_intermediateField` (line 104) are unnecessary public wrappers around existing tower instances.

summary: Three public tower declarations duplicate existing Mathlib instance API and should be removed.
